comparator.name: Natural Sciences
comparator.sourceNotes: Exact current ordinary full-time BSc Natural Sciences 56948, Radboud. Dutch legally controlling 2026–27 OER v1.1, adopted 9 July and amended 6 October 2026, establishes 60 EC first year, 30 EC later shared core, 72 EC specialisation (selected first-listed Physical Chemistry: 33 required plus 39 restricted), 6 EC genuine free electives and 12 EC individual internship: 180 total. No unspecialised route exists; Physical Chemistry is a neutral official-order tie break, not a UCR-fit choice. Biophysics and Biochemistry remain separate alternatives and are not merged. First-listed current choices are MOL136, MOL155, MOL170A, FFIL100, MOL040 and MOL157. Restricted space uses non-overlapping eligible NWI bachelor courses and/or permitted 15–30 EC minor; excluded minors Physical Organic Chemistry, Bio-organic Chemistry and Sustainable Chemistry and listed overlapping combinations apply. The OER reference to Article7.6 for minor exclusions is a cross-reference typo: the actual exclusion list is Article7.7. Prospective 2027–28 web tables instead show 24 shared and 78 specialisation EC; they do not replace current 30/72. Article7.2 designates Dutch although most courses are English, unlike the general English recruitment-page label. First-year MOL0861 Academic Skills is 0 EC inside the later MOL086 3 EC; compulsory RADAr participation/reflection is noncredit. Writing MOL190 requires passed MOL0861. Academic skills completion occurs in the final year, not before research starts. Internship MOL200A requires full B1 plus at least60 later EC (120 total), departmental prior knowledge as checked before MOL200R administrative admission, approved proposal, individual supervised theoretical/practical work and written/oral reports. Project and Sustainability Certificate participation are recorded for the internship. BSA39 EC. Course-specific prior knowledge and laboratory participation remain applicable; no individual elective plan is certified. Old-cohort substitutions and examination-only historical options are not added to the selected current route.

routeSelection.basis: The generic target names no specialisation. The adopted EER offers three equally formal combinations of two natural sciences, each with a common 60-EC first year and 30-EC later core; it identifies no general unspecialised route. The first-listed Physical Chemistry option is the neutral official-order tie break after testing for a broader route, without reference to the UCR catalogue.

exception.reason: UCR provides substantive biochemistry, molecular biology and laboratory skills, environmental science, mathematics and data analysis. Neither proposed programme sustains the defining physics and chemistry combination of Natural Sciences and the selected Physical Chemistry route. Advanced mechanics, electromagnetism, quantum theory, chemical analysis and synthesis, bonding and physical chemistry remain missing as a coherent sequence. Adding sustainability materials teaching, neuroscience or machine learning does not repair that disciplinary gap. No complete defensible UCR alternative is established. This is a weighted academic judgment, not a demand for identical degrees or professional equivalence.

exception.ucrCourseEvidence: All36 selected actual enriched profiles and48 original placements reviewed. Alternative1:45EC life sciences,67.5environment/ecology,60quantitative methods,7.5PPD. Alternative2:105EC biomedical/life/brain,67.5quantitative methods/research synthesis,7.5PPD. Both formally feasible; neither sustains the defining physics/chemistry sequence. Four additional relevant profiles assessed for bounded reconstruction.

candidateAssessment.label: Sustainability materials and quantitative natural science reconstruction
candidateAssessment.reason: Scanned all 151 actual workbook course names, tracks and content for physics, chemistry, laboratory, materials and research capabilities. Read the four additional relevant profiles recorded here. ENSGATE201 can precede ENSDELT311 in 2028h2 and both have genuine contributions; their combined sustainability/materials teaching does not supply missing advanced mechanics, electromagnetism, quantum mechanics, bonding, chemical analysis and synthesis. No coherent complete target response can be reconstructed by relabelling adjacent biology, mathematics, AI or design. No deep reading of every one of the 151 profiles is claimed.

interestConstructionAssessment.disposition: The programme combines physics, chemistry and biology; selected route deepens physics/chemistry. UCR biological and environmental breadth alone is insufficient. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestConstructionAssessment.studentInterest: solving scientific problems across disciplinary boundaries
interestConstructionAssessment.disposition: Official interdisciplinary problem solving is defining; UCR general methods contribute without the required disciplinary interface. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestConstructionAssessment.studentInterest: using mathematics to understand natural science
interestConstructionAssessment.disposition: Mathematics is required, including calculus and linear algebra. UCR contributes genuine mathematics but does not thereby supply physics/chemistry. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Scientific applications motivate the degree; examples are not guaranteed projects or equivalent UCR content. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Biology/physics interface is a distinct permitted direction, not the selected Physical Chemistry route. UCR neuroscience is not neurophysics. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Biochemistry is a genuine common first-year component and a separate specialisation. UCR biochemistry contributes without replacing chemistry sequences. No retained UCR programme ownership.

interestConstructionAssessment.studentInterest: the physics behind chemical and material processes
interestConstructionAssessment.disposition: The selected Physical Chemistry route explicitly studies chemical/material physical processes; no comparable UCR sequence established. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Biochemistry is an alternative specialisation, not an extra compulsory component of the selected route. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Biophysics is an alternative specialisation; its requirements must not be pooled into Physical Chemistry. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Physical Chemistry is the neutral first-listed selected route, with 33 required and 39 restricted EC. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Biophysics is an alternative field, not a universal selected-route course or a UCR neuroscience equivalence. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Quantum mechanics is current shared compulsory6EC; UCR linear algebra supports it but is not quantum teaching. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Nanoscience is an official direction/example, not an additional universal compulsory course or a UCR materials guarantee. No retained UCR programme ownership.
DNA/molecular methods appear in biological directions; UCR molecular lab is genuine partial contribution, not chemical analysis/synthesis. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Molecular methods include practical science; UCR biological lab does not establish the physical/chemical methods sequence. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Analytical reasoning is supported by programme objectives; general UCR research and maths contribute. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Biochemical processes are genuinely taught; substantial UCR biochemistry is preserved as partial evidence. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Molecular data is an applicable direction; generic data science is not domain-specific molecular experimental competence. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Crystal structure, chemical bonding and the permitted solid-state option evidence the materials direction; generic image processing does not replace it. No retained UCR programme ownership.

Mechanics and laboratory plus later advanced mechanics are required; no UCR physical-mechanics sequence identified. No retained UCR programme ownership.

Academic writing/skills are required, including MOL0861 before writing and final-year completion. UCR methods/PPD are general support. No retained UCR programme ownership.

Chemical Bonding3EC is required in selected Physical Chemistry; no molecular-biology substitution. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Comparative physiology belongs to alternative biological specialisations; human physiology is narrower. No retained UCR programme ownership.

Electricity and Magnetism6EC and later Electromagnetism6EC are selected requirements; UCR signals analysis is not electromagnetic theory. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Neurophysics is a separate specialisation/postgraduate direction; neural networks and cognitive neuroscience are not physical neurobiology. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Thermodynamics3EC and selected Thermodynamics2 3EC are distinct required components. No retained UCR programme ownership.
Teaching physics/chemistry is an optional minor/direction subject to exclusions and later teacher qualification; not universally required or promised by UCR. No retained UCR programme ownership.

audience.programmeDescription: Natural Sciences at Radboud combines physics, chemistry and biology to investigate scientific problems across their boundaries. Students develop mathematical and experimental skills before specialising in physical chemistry, biophysics or biochemistry.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers useful study in biochemistry, molecular biology, environmental science, mathematics and data analysis. These courses do not sustain the combination of physical theory, chemistry and laboratory work that defines this degree. We therefore show Radboud’s curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a comparable alternative.

curriculum.limitation: The selected 180 EC route includes 60 EC in the first year, 30 EC of later shared courses, 33 EC of required Physical Chemistry courses, 39 EC of restricted specialisation electives, 6 EC of free electives and a 12 EC individual research internship. Where the regulations allow alternatives, the first listed current course is shown. Biophysics and Biochemistry are separate routes. First-year Academic Skills and language-test participation add no credits. The internship has prior-study and approval requirements. The programme is formally Dutch, with most courses taught in English.
